findings.title: Four production guards and clamps are deletable with no driver in their measured closure failing
findings.claim: Removing any of four single production lines -- legionella.py:528, optimizer.py:3131, sensor.py:2547, thermal_model.py:1309 -- leaves every driver in that line's measured closure producing the same exit status and the same failing-check count, including tests/features.py and the differential tests/env_drift.py --all, while each removal is a real behaviour change.
findings.mechanism: The four lines are defensive: a Repairs-issue de-duplication, a horizon-length pad, a payload-type guard and a setpoint clamp. Each fires only on an input no driver constructs (a second tick with an unchanged ceiling signature; a min_temp_margins array shorter than n_steps; a truthy non-list insight.narrative.items; a tank above its setpoint in the coil-draw path), so no assertion observes either arm.

findings.proposed_fix_scope: Add one driver per demonstrated seam: a second LegionellaGuard.check_ceiling tick whose signature is unchanged (the issue is not re-created); a _build_comfort_bounds call with min_temp_margins shorter than the horizon (the result is padded, not raised); a PlanNarrativeSensor.native_value read over a truthy non-list items payload (None, not 'idle'); a dhw_coil_draw_reduction call with the tank above the setpoint (clamped). Each must import and call the production symbol, never a copy of it.

findings.title: A mutation-table kill can be credited to a driver that reports no violation
findings.claim: tests/mutation_table.py counts a changed exit status as a kill, and tests/structure.py exits 2 for a mutant that only IMPROVED a structure metric -- its own output says 'Nothing here is a violation' -- so a mutant no assertion covers is recorded as killed; over the frozen 40-mutant sample this channel produced 1 kill with zero failing checks anywhere.
findings.mechanism: A single-line GUARD_OFF makes the guarded block statically unreachable, so tests/structure.py's call-edge screen stops counting the calls inside it; cut_learning falls 285 -> 284, the metric ratchet refuses an unrecorded improvement with exit 2, and mutation_table's kill rule reads the exit-status change as a detection. The mutant's behaviour change is covered by no assertion, so the recorded survivor_fraction under-states how blind the suite is.

findings.proposed_fix_scope: tests/mutation_table.py's kill rule should key on the failing-check signal it already reads (#805) for drivers whose non-zero exit is not a violation, or tests/structure.py's rc=2 arm should be excluded from the kill rule by name, with the reason stated beside the rule. Either way the recorded survivor_fraction is re-taken, because last_measured.full already sits exactly at its cap (0.30 of 0.30).
